profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with 5 successful years in the Autonomous Vehicle Mapping Software Team at General Motors. Proficient in Python programming, I specialize in crafting innovative mapping solutions for self-driving vehicles. I've significantly improved map data testing efficiency by overhauling the testing framework, alongside developing and upholding a robust data flow process that is essential for transforming complex source map data into functional vehicle maps. Beyond technical achievements, I'm dedicated to fostering teamwork, mentoring new hires, and facilitating their seamless integration into projects and the codebase. I'm an active participant in cross-functional endeavors, contributing to data and system integration tasks, and driving cohesive collaboration across teams. Based in El Paso, Texas, I am passionate about shaping the future of autonomous technology and advancing self-driving vehicles to new frontiers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a dynamic Course Catalog platform, replacing static PDFs with a searchable system.  
• Developed an admin portal for the MyRide transportation system, streamlining the approval process for bus requests.  
• Utilized Angular, ASP.NET C#, and Python to enhance functionality and efficiency in educational technology.

positions.title: Autonomous Mapping Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the design and maintenance of Python-based backend APIs supporting autonomous mapping systems and consumer-facing vehicle software
- Worked with large structured datasets and backend data pipelines using tools such as Parquet, SQLite, and PySpark to support scalable data processing and validation
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to diagnose data quality issues, improve validation workflows, and support reliable production deployments

positions.title: Software Integration Engineer
positions.description:
- Supported software integration and issue triage across pre-production vehicles by collecting logs, analyzing failures, and coordinating fixes with engineering teams
- Used CAN/LIN diagnostic tools for logging, module flashing, and validation to support vehicle software releases
- Assisted with validating software updates and ensuring compliance with internal configuration and release standards

positions.title: Controller Integration Engineer
positions.description:
- Participated in HIL bench and controller testing to validate embedded software against system requirements and design specifications
- Supported vehicle software update deployments across multiple platforms, assisting with troubleshooting and validation activities
- Contributed to ADAS-related validation efforts by working with sensor, chassis, and powertrain data in test environments

positions.title: Autonomous Sensing Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a standardized LiDAR performance test
- Analyzed autonomous vehicle BAG files utilizing ROS (robot operating system)

positions.title: Research and Development Director
positions.description: Developing new STEM projects for students and improving STEM education within girls (STEM Dolls)
